reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Operating Cilium in `--datapath-mode=lb-only` for plain Docker mode now requires to add an additional `--enable-k8s=false` to the command line, otherwise it is…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Without --enable-k8s=false, Cilium in lb-only datapath mode under plain Docker assumes Kubernetes is present.

proposed.statement: Running Cilium with --datapath-mode=lb-only in plain Docker mode now requires adding --enable-k8s=false, otherwise Kubernetes is assumed to be present.
